channel.title: Palm Coast Observer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Palm Coast Observer (observerlocalnews.com)

item.title: Flagler's overall crime rate is down 32% from 2024, Flagler Sheriff says
item.description: Despite a population increase of 4,000, reported crimes against persons decreased by 27% and reported crimes against property decreased by 26%.

item.title: Voluntary annexation approved: 240 acres incorporated into Bunnell
item.description: Bunnell City Commission approves first reading; land will remain zoned agricultural under city regulations

item.title: Volusia County Schools reports record 73.8% College and Career Acceleration rate
item.description: The rate measures the number of graduates who earned college credit through AP, dual enrollment, AICE or IB courses, earned an industry certification, or completed a CTE program.

item.title: Daytona Beach brush fire near Mosaic neighborhood grows to 160 acres in one day
item.description: The fire, called the Bennet Field Fire, started out 20-25 acres in size west of Mosaic early on Feb. 23.

item.title: 4 letters: Readers comment on Flock cameras, water recycling, SB 180 and insurance rate reform
item.description: What are your neighbors talking about this week?

item.title: Volusia County Council to revisit decision to withhold 2025 cultural arts grants
item.description: The council will discuss the fate of over $570K in cultural arts grants at its meeting on March 3.

item.title: Ormond Beach family transforms tennis club in The Trails
item.description: Asaf and Avi Breier are aiming to make Trailside Tennis Club a facility that will develop junior athletes, support longtime players and create a sense of community.

item.title: Flagler County ends conflicts with Flagler Beach over Summertown development
item.description: The Flagler County Commission voted 4-1 to end a conflict resolution process over the Summertown development in Flagler Beach. Commission Kim Carney was the sole vote against it.

item.title: The NASCAR Foundation awards grant to Halifax Health to expand pediatric telemedicine, Child Life Services
item.description: Halifax Health received a total of $450,000 from the NASCAR Foundation.

item.title: Palm Coast to update council's vacancy procedures, borrowing power in November
item.description: 'We need to make sure that the ones we're putting on here are the important ones,' Councilman Ty Miller said. More updates to the charter will be spread out over other elections.
